completion_boundary: Fresh source binding only. Historical E1 and beta1 evidence do not qualify these new bytes; rebuild, installed-client, maintenance and final-delivery qualification remain pending.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Canonical scope source exists; this supplement does not rerun the complete native/Go parity matrix.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Go and native readers produce identical canonical scope digests; reject extra/duplicate fields, wildcard roots, missing identities, unsupported versions and mismatched profile/source evidence before a mutable attempt.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Direct native scope enforcement remains source-bound; final delivered-owner acceptance is open.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: A direct native prepare request outside the approved effects is refused even if Python/CLI validation is bypassed. Staged exact bytes cannot bypass scope or dependency blockers.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Unrelated profile effects remain outside authorization; final complete user-profile journeys are open.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Scope A while B has independently ready install/select/deactivate/undock/uninstall actions. B's files, selection and ownership claims remain unchanged through each A replan.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Exact effect identity must survive replanning; fresh-host progression remains unaccepted.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: A's next valid action changes ID after verified progress: exact authorized effect is allowed; changed target receipt/root/receptor/kind or extra uninstall receipt is refused.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Unapproved dependencies remain blockers; no automatic authorization or selection.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: A requires action B: full-plan prerequisite remains visible and blocks A; B is not automatically authorized. Explicit new review is required to include its effect. PR #199 retained-dependency regression remains effective.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Unknown/adopted/shared ownership remains blocked; fixture evidence is bounded.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Ownership reconciliation preserves out-of-scope and other-profile claims; no hidden stale-claim pruning, root adoption or partial-inventory substitution. Unknown shared-root evidence blocks mutation.

evidence_refs.expected: Effect completion leaves selection pending; it is not global convergence.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Scoped effect completion is not full profile convergence or selection.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Scope finishes with unrelated divergence: terminal scoped result is true, global convergence is false, full applied-state evidence is unchanged. Next scope is a new exact linked operation.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Legacy and incompatible reader/recovery paths remain distinct; no new universal compatibility claim.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Old writer/recovery client, missing critical scope extension, changed scope on retry, incompatible replacement coordinator and scope downgrade all refuse. Legacy unscoped journals retain their explicit full-profile semantics.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Seven Go deliveries are catalogued; unknown owner/version/arguments have no fallback route.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: All seven Go units map to exact supported owners. Component/owner/compiled-version substitution, forged argv and unknown critical owner metadata refuse before execution.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Fresh stopped installations are E1; no enrollment, host activation or fresh-host acceptance is inferred.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Install SSIAG, STAV and Accordare through their actual installers in fresh isolated prefixes; independently verify owner-generated receipt, final executable bytes and native refusal behavior. No enrollment/start is inferred from package install.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Two packaging builds do not constitute two distinct compatible native releases.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Different packaging builds of one native version coexist in distinct prefixes; a different byte set cannot overwrite the same immutable path. Old exact owner can recover/uninstall only its bound installation.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Raw executable custody is not a native receipt; future selection does not stop current sessions.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: qxctl/SSH/stdio raw-delivery custody never masquerades as a native receipt. Changing future launch selection leaves existing sessions unchanged; uncertain use keeps old bytes retained.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Full final-byte qxctl selection and host-slot rollback journeys remain open.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Failed next-qxctl identity/protocol probe leaves old selection intact. Successful explicit selection retains old recovery binary; configured Linux host slots/fallbacks remain under their real host owner.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: Conda carries inert administrator bytes; privileged host provisioning and replacement remain separate.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Nonroot Conda install cannot provision/elevate the optional administrator. Pending attempts bind old exact binary; reviewed admin replacement preserves profile/history/audit and required recovery bytes.

d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Run applicable installed-owner/service-manager lanes on all four core profiles and selected supplements, including user/system privilege and race cases. Missing host or manager is incomplete, not a pass.

d05_safety_acceptance.remaining_limit: S08 candidate binding is preparation; signatures, real retrieval, independent review and publication remain open.
d05_safety_acceptance.requirement: Bind final candidate bytes, recipe/source/export/toolchain, exact owner capabilities, signatures, retrieval and real two-release results. Independent reviewer checks a failure, its correction and recovery outcome.
